SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
WEDNESDAY - APRIL 26, 2017 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT HELD ON APRIL 26,
2017, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125 BLOOMFIELD
AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Mark Lohman, Associate Pastor, New Life
  Community Church.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was given by Mayor George Ray’s granddaughters Kylee
  Thompkins and Makena Brower.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Carol Chen
  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Naresh Solanki
  Mayor/Chair George Ray

5.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected
  to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

6.  Introductions

  Mayor Ray introduced dignitaries in attendance. Each Councilmember, the Mayor
  Pro Tem, and the Mayor introduced their family and guests in attendance.

7.  Recognition and presentations to outgoing Councilmember Carol Chen

  Presentations were made to outgoing Councilmember Carol Chen. A video was
  displayed highlighting Councilmember Chen’s years of service.

8.  Comments from outgoing Councilmember Carol Chen

  Comments were made by Councilmember Carol Chen.

9.  Recognition and presentations to outgoing Mayor Ray

  Presentations were made to outgoing Mayor George Ray. A video was displayed
  highlighting Mayor Ray’s years of service.

10.  Comments from outgoing Mayor Ray

  Comments were made by Mayor Ray.
 City of Cerritos  April 26, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 3

11.  Comments from City Councilmembers to outgoing Councilmembers.

  None.

12.  City Clerk administers Oath of Office to newly elected Council/Agency
  members

  City Clerk Vida Barone administered the Oath of Office to newly elected
  Council/Agency members Grace Hu and Frank Yokoyama.

  The Council/Agency members were seated as follows:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Mark Pulido
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Council/Agency Member Frank Yokoyama

13.  City Council/Successor Agency reorganization. Selection of Mayor/Chair
  and Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair

  Vida Barone, City Clerk, declared the office of Mayor/Chair vacant and called for
  nominations for the office of Mayor/Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Yokoyama nominated Council/Agency Member Hu for the
  office of Mayor/Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Edwards nominated Council/Agency Member Solanki for
  the office of Mayor/Chair.

  Noting there were no further nominations, the City Clerk declared nominations
  closed.

  MOTION: As nominated by Council/Agency Member Yokoyama, Council/Agency
  Member Hu, was presented for consideration as Mayor/Chair. The motion carried (3 -
  2) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Pulido, Yokoyama
  NOES:  Edwards, Solanki
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  The City Clerk declared Council/Agency Member Hu elected to the office of
  Mayor/Chair by acclamation.

  The office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair was declared vacant by Mayor/Chair Hu
  and she called for nominations for the office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Yokoyama nominated Council/Agency Member Pulido for
  the office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Solanki nominated Council/Agency Member Edwards for
  the office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Noting there were no further nominations, Mayor/Chair Hu declared nominations
  closed.
 City of Cerritos  April 26, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 3

13.  City Council/Successor Agency reorganization. Selection of Mayor/Chair
  and Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair (continued)

  MOTION: As nominated by Council/Agency Member Yokoyama, Council/Agency
  Member Pulido was presented for consideration as Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair. The
  motion carried (3 - 2) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Pulido, Yokoyama
  NOES:  Edwards, Solanki
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  The City Clerk declared Council/Agency Member Pulido elected to the office of
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair by acclamation.

14.  Comments from newly designated Mayor/Chair and Council/Agency
  members

  Council/Agency Member Edwards, Mayor/Chair Hu, Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair
  Pulido, and Council/Agency Member Yokoyama made brief comments.

  Council/Agency Member Yokoyama and Mayor/Chair Hu introduced their families
  and thanked their supporters.

  Mayor/Chair Hu invited the community to a reception at the Cerritos Center for
  the Performing Arts.

15.  Adjournment

  The meeting was adjourned at 9:15 p.m.
